purpose: Record unavailable customer or authority data so later delivery can be validated without reopening model gates automatically.

delivery_rules.admission_rule: Receipt of a file only changes request status; K0, traditional-model, GWM-training and production gates require separate quality review.

requests.requested_from: DMT or municipal GIS/survey engineering owner
requests.minimum_delivery: Engineering DTM/LiDAR or surveyed surface covering the study area, plus vertical control and breaklines.
requests.time_requirement: Current version plus acquisition date; historical 2024 surface if materially different.
requests.spatial_requirement: <=2 m preferred for engineering model; documented coarser resolution accepted for first K0 review.
requests.current_substitute: SRTM/Copernicus 30 m and SmartMakani contours, diagnostic only.
acceptance_checks: coverage includes candidate outfalls and drainage catchments

requests.requested_from: Stormwater asset and drainage operations owner
requests.minimum_delivery: Versioned network inventory with engineering units and deterministic identity relationships.
requests.time_requirement: Snapshot valid for 2024-04 event and current snapshot with change history.
requests.spatial_requirement: EPSG:32640 or lossless transform with documented accuracy.
requests.current_substitute: SmartMakani layer 37 and registered Makani PostgreSQL candidates; topology and units not admitted.
acceptance_checks: duplicate and orphan rules are documented

requests.minimum_delivery: Rain gauge and/or radar QPE for the target event plus at least one independent validation event.
requests.time_requirement: 2024-04-15..17, <=5 min gauge preferred, <=15 min QPE acceptable; UTC alignment required.
requests.spatial_requirement: Station coordinates or gridded QPE covering all subcatchments; documented radar footprint.
requests.current_substitute: Open-Meteo, NASA POWER/MERRA2 and CHIRPS; diagnostic sensitivity only.
acceptance_checks: event totals reconcile to source report

requests.requested_from: DMT/coastal authority, port operator or tide-gauge owner
requests.minimum_delivery: Observed or authoritative hindcast water levels at applicable outfalls for the event and validation event.
requests.time_requirement: 2024-04-15..17, hourly or finer; include at least 12 h pre-event and 24 h post-event.
requests.spatial_requirement: Each boundary series must map to one or more modeled outfalls with documented interpolation rule.
requests.current_substitute: Free-outfall assumption and static SmartMakani bathymetry; not coastal-calibration evidence.
acceptance_checks: storm-surge and tide components are not double counted

requests.requested_from: Stormwater operations, SCADA and maintenance owner
requests.minimum_delivery: Event-aligned controls and measured response for pumps, gates, storage and outfalls.
requests.time_requirement: 2024-04-15..17 plus at least one non-event operating period; 5-15 min preferred.
requests.spatial_requirement: Facility IDs must crosswalk to the authoritative drainage network and outfalls.
requests.current_substitute: Static pump/outfall candidates without event operations; no operational admission.
acceptance_checks: command and actual state are distinguishable

requests.requested_from: DMT, municipality, emergency response, roads and transport operations
requests.minimum_delivery: Timestamped observations for model calibration and independent holdout validation.
requests.time_requirement: At least the 2024-04 event; observations during rise, peak and recession preferred.
requests.spatial_requirement: Point or polygon geometry with uncertainty; target subnet and representative city zones required.
requests.current_substitute: SmartMakani rain incidents/MIMS location proxies and public reports; no validated depth or duration.
acceptance_checks: depth units and datum are explicit

requests.minimum_delivery: Approved common spatial unit and deterministic overlay rules across drainage, inundation and liveability data.
requests.time_requirement: Version valid for the event and current planning snapshot.
requests.spatial_requirement: EPSG:32640 working grid or approved lossless transform.
requests.current_substitute: BBox clipping and candidate crosswalks; no per-asset overlay admission.
acceptance_checks: one-to-many and boundary cases are specified

requests.requested_from: Liveability business data owner and privacy owner
requests.minimum_delivery: Approved definitions and snapshot for population, facilities, roads, plots and priority scores.
requests.time_requirement: Snapshot aligned to the target event plus current planning snapshot.
requests.spatial_requirement: Crosswalk to approved common geography; no uncontrolled per-person output.
requests.current_substitute: Customer-side liveability candidate snapshot; semantic and snapshot alignment not admitted.
acceptance_checks: snapshot hash and row-count receipt are available

requests.requested_from: DMT land-use/GIS owner and drainage model owner
requests.minimum_delivery: Land cover and imperviousness classes linked to infiltration and roughness parameters.
requests.time_requirement: Version near 2024 event and current version.
requests.spatial_requirement: Resolution sufficient for modeled subcatchments; document resampling rule.
requests.current_substitute: Temporary subcatchment assumptions in diagnostic SWMM/ANUGA runs.

requests.requested_from: DMT topography, roads and building GIS owners
requests.minimum_delivery: Road surfaces, curbs, walls, embankments, building footprints/heights and verified low points.
requests.time_requirement: Version near 2024 event and current version where changed.
requests.spatial_requirement: Engineering geometry in EPSG:32640 or documented transform.
requests.current_substitute: SmartMakani contours/buildings and public context vectors; not engineering micro-topography.
acceptance_checks: vertical units and datum are explicit
invalid geometries are repaired with audit

requests.requested_from: NCM, drainage authority and planning/modeling owner
requests.minimum_delivery: Multiple historical rainfall/boundary/operation/impact events and approved design storm definitions.
requests.time_requirement: At least one 2024 extreme event and multiple independent events; design horizons as specified by authority.
requests.spatial_requirement: Same spatial and temporal contracts as production model.
requests.current_substitute: Synthetic fixtures and public reanalysis proxies only.
acceptance_checks: holdout events are not used for training

requests.minimum_delivery: Condition, blockage, cleaning and failure history for inlets, pipes, pumps and gates.
requests.time_requirement: At least 2023-2024 history and current condition snapshot.
requests.spatial_requirement: Asset IDs crosswalk to authoritative network.
requests.current_substitute: No condition data; diagnostic runs assume fixed capacity.

model_gate_summary.next_gate: When any package arrives, run source/CRS/time/unit/hash checks, then update the existing K0 request receipt; do not infer admission from file receipt alone.
